task.title: Refresh stale V2 provider health without unrelated task demand

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor Authority V2 idle delivery-health target selection, an authorized bounded bypass of a cached future retry_at, and the existing runtime-state observation projection.
not_changing: TaskStore or canonical task lifecycle write ownership
retired V1 pause, recovery, or capacity control planes
product services, frontend, production, or capital authority

prior_round_gap.finding: The prior head (19836b33d) only refreshed endpoint/account evidence once the existing retry gate already considered it due. Live codex1 stayed closed behind a stale quota_terminal retry_at=2026-08-22T14:09:00Z even though a direct probe already succeeded, because health_gate_for_endpoint intentionally never bypasses a future retry_at.
prior_round_gap.resolution: Added an authorized bypass scan (authorized_delivery_health_refresh_targets) that fires only on an exact delivery-topology change or an explicit Human/Ops request, may probe past a cached future retry_at, and is consumed once per cycle so it never becomes an every-cycle probe.

contract.idle_trigger: build_dispatch_plan adds a pure idle target scan after task and reassignment demand. A startup cycle with an empty task board therefore reaches due stale endpoint/account evidence without manufacturing a queue event or changing canonical task state.
contract.authorized_bypass_trigger: authorized_delivery_health_refresh_targets returns targets only when the exact endpoint/provider/account topology fingerprint differs from the last one this process recorded (covers supervisor startup, since a fresh state has no prior fingerprint, and any real config-topology change), or when request_delivery_health_refresh has recorded a pending Human/Ops request. It skips any lane whose endpoint and account are both already healthy, and never runs unconditionally.
contract.bypass_consumption: record_delivery_health_refresh_authority_consumed persists the current topology fingerprint and clears a spent Human/Ops request inside the same apply_post_dispatch_maintenance transaction that commits this cycle's probe observations, so an unchanged topology cannot retrigger the bypass on the next cycle.
contract.human_ops_entry_point: supervisor.py --request-delivery-health-refresh records the request through runtime_state_update (the governed locked read-modify-write primitive) and exits without starting the poll loop; it never edits state.json by hand.
contract.target_boundary: Only configured logical delivery lanes and their configured endpoints are considered (shared _configured_delivery_endpoints helper). A provider configured without a delivery endpoint, even when it shares an account, cannot create a probe demand.
contract.bounded_io: probe_demanded_delivery_health continues to deduplicate exact endpoint IDs and invokes no more than delivery_health.refresh_max_per_cycle live probes in one cycle. Task and reassignment demand remain first in the combined target order; the authorized bypass targets are folded in alongside the due-only idle targets, still capped by the same refresh_max_per_cycle bound.
contract.fail_closed: A fresh live success updates endpoint and account evidence together through apply_delivery_health_observations, atomically clearing the prior stale state. A failed auth probe writes the endpoint unavailable; no stale or synthetic cached readiness is admitted regardless of which scan proposed the probe.
contract.write_authority: Both target scans are read-only. Live probes remain post-delivery I/O, and health observations plus the refresh-authority bookkeeping are committed only through apply_post_dispatch_maintenance inside the existing reserved runtime-maintenance transaction. No TaskStore, state-file, or activity-log writer was added.

idle_without_task_demand.proof: An empty task board yields exact codex1 and claude2 targets from expired auth/quota evidence, then successful live observations set both endpoint and distinct account records healthy.

bounded_and_orphan_safe.proof: A configured-but-undeliverable provider sharing codex_account is absent from the target list; refresh_max_per_cycle=1 produces exactly one live probe.

failed_probe_fail_closed.proof: A live auth-material failure records codex as unavailable and does not invent an account-health success.

authorized_bypass_of_future_retry_at.proof: With a codex account stuck at retry_after/quota_terminal and retry_at in the year 2999, the due-only scan returns no target, but the authorized scan on a fresh (startup) state returns exactly the codex endpoint and skips the already-healthy codex2 lane.

bypass_bounded_not_every_cycle.proof: After the bypass fires once and is consumed, an unchanged topology yields no target on the next call; adding a real delivery endpoint changes the topology fingerprint and authorizes exactly one more bypass.

human_ops_explicit_request.proof: With topology already recorded (no startup/topology trigger), request_delivery_health_refresh alone authorizes one bypass of the future retry_at; consuming it clears the request so the next cycle does not re-fire.

v2_regression_boundary.proof: Full Supervisor Authority V2, runtime-state, provider-health, and dispatch-admission suites remain green; the established account-first TTL/retry predicate is reused rather than duplicated.

required: Confirm idle target selection and the authorized bypass scan are pure and do not write TaskStore or runtime files.
Confirm the bypass fires only on a genuine topology-fingerprint change or a consumed Human/Ops request, never unconditionally per cycle.
Confirm a fresh live success still atomically clears prior stale endpoint/account state, and a failed probe stays fail-closed, for targets proposed by either scan.
Confirm the bounded probe cap (refresh_max_per_cycle) still applies once bypass targets are folded into the combined demand.
Confirm no V1 pause or recovery control plane is reintroduced.

post_merge_rollout.authority: Human/Ops or the supervisor deployment authority
post_merge_rollout.action: Promote the exact merged dev command runtime. If the live codex1 quota_terminal retry_at is still in the future, run `.orchestrator/supervisor.py --request-delivery-health-refresh` once against the live runtime state, then run one bounded supervisor cycle and read the live runtime delivery_health state.
acceptance_readback: codex1 account has a fresh healthy live observation from a configured codex1 endpoint, even though its prior retry_at was still in the future
claude2 endpoint and its distinct claude2 account have fresh healthy live observations
no provider-only shared-account orphan appears in delivery_health
post_merge_rollout.rollback: Promote the last accepted command runtime. V2 remains fail-closed on stale evidence; no credential or TaskStore rollback is required.
